title: Perceptual Crossing Device Technical Paper – Data Set Validation
authors: Stephen Estelle et al. (associated paper authors)
version: Four osfstorage file IDs; each version 1, updated 2024-02-15; see file-manifest.csv
finding: 4 ZIPs checked by external SHA-256, 44 non-AppleDouble CSV/marker entries; 7 copies in MotorExtraDataset also occur in MotorDataset. Distinct entries include 32 controller trials (1,053,083 samples) and five BrainVision marker series (4,254 Response events). Six trials per chosen condition independently aligned.

title: Enactive Torch Technical Paper – Validation from Matlab
authors: Stephen Estelle et al. (associated paper authors)
version: 5 BrainVision marker files and 4 MATLAB scripts, osfstorage v1; see file manifest
finding: Five runs include sensor/manual and computer-command triggers for internal/external motors. Last eligible source marker before the first acoustic box signal closes one pair. Internal retained cohorts give 143 and 121 pairs matching published means; alternate external cohort handling tabulated. No subject EEG files collected.
rights: Open OSF project; node_license is null. Paper lists CC BY for design/CAD files. Validation marker and script reuse terms not separately confirmed. Only independently calculated statistics and file metadata redistributed.

title: ExtremControl human and robot hand wave – annotated same-camera motion demonstration
finding: 359 encoded frames at 30000/1001 Hz, on-screen half-speed caption. Three mask thresholds on the color-annotated hand regions give peak lags of 3–4 encoded frames (50.05–66.73 ms physical). Use as repeated-motion phase evidence; presentation edits and unknown exposure limit precision.
rights: Project page footer CC BY-SA 4.0 for website; video-specific grant not separately verified. Only derived numerical summaries and hashes saved.
